data.gender_notes: Naureen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-r-n', meaning 'to be light, to be pleasant'. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the light of guidance from Allah. The name Naureen carries the meaning “Light, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naureen usually hope their child will grow to embody light, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naureen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
